score: Mean over h=1..9 and all pixels of clamp(mean_channel_abs(real[t+h]-real[t])/0.1,0,1)
sorting: ascending score, then ascending start; 42 windows per quartile
use: Post-hoc evaluation stratification only; labels depend on true images and are never supplied to the model
limits: Global image change can include hand motion, occlusion or illumination and is not tracked object motion or action success. The grouping is defined while stage B is training, not before stage B was launched.
